channel.title: Theme Radar
channel.description: Thematic equity research and the baskets that track it.

item.title: Binance heist: what it means for our cyber basket
item.description: The largest crypto theft on record ran through a poisoned package, a fake job offer, an over-privileged token and an internal AI tool. No change to the basket, but it points to identity and software supply chain. A fear-driven slowdown in AI agents helps the basket. A return-driven one is the real risk.

item.title: Cybersecurity hardware: Fortinet and F5
item.description: Both names fell about 20% on earnings in the same week. The moat is being physically in the data path inside the customer's building, which AI cannot vibe-code. Own the category at equal weight, but wait: the entry conditions and kill triggers are set out name by name.

item.title: If frontier AI labs are becoming the next generation of biotech platforms, how should we position?
item.description: Frontier AI labs are buying biotechs, building wet labs and starting their own drug programmes. Design gets cheap and validation stays scarce, so the physical layer gets paid: molecule makers, lab tools, testing services and data owners.

item.title: Update on the cybersecurity basket: six new names
item.description: Five weeks in, the nine-name basket is up 11.4% against 6.0% for IGV. We map security spend into eight layers, ask where AI agents push growth fastest, and add six names: MSFT, FROG, QLYS, ACN, CACI and MITK.

item.title: Passport Control for Robots: SAIL vs OKTA
item.description: AI agents pay the identity registry, not the login. Governance is priced per identity, login per employee. Within listed identity, SailPoint owns the better-placed layer at the lower multiple.

item.title: The Mall Is Closing: Shopify, Meta's Muse and the Agentic Storefront
item.description: When AI agents do the shopping, the rails get paid every time (Shopify), the assistant that knows the buyer earns a commission (Meta), and the everything store has to reinvent itself or shrink (Amazon).

item.title: AI agentic beneficiaries: cybersecurity theme primer and shopping list
item.description: Who gets paid when software starts doing the work: the traffic, the control points and the record-keeping that every AI agent has to pass through. A shopping list, built before the down day we cannot time.
